control: exact scored E01 ZIP 0311b8a71ff9498aaaca30a8a6d22be5622a62539eaef0360dd585d401fe3af9; never repeat its official upload
treatment: E01 prompt plus only the original pre-edit contract prefix; inert NOTICE addition
other_prompt_factors: full E01 prompt and coverage checkpoint unchanged; E02 not included
task_eligibility: public development tasks; exclude all previously inspected or used tasks and hidden data; freeze IDs, source hashes, soundness and exposure exclusions before model use
arm_order: alternate control-treatment and treatment-control across paired tasks
matching: same immutable task snapshot, environment, exact model and initialization, seed policy and grader; record all unavoidable deviations
clock_scope: 12 arms x 480 seconds; excludes startup, final grading and cleanup; separately budget actual accelerator quota factor
primary_endpoint: paired completed task outcome; report wins, losses and denominators including errors and unfinished tasks
mechanism_endpoints: contract recorded before first tool invocation
falsification: contracts absent before decisions, contradictions not reduced, or time/call cost without better completed outcomes reject the mechanism; tiny-screen results cannot establish score superiority
